sevenrooms.method: public.reservations joined to public.venues, venue 'Hutong Dubai', is_deleted false, created week in Asia/Dubai. Website source set for Dubai = 'Booking Widget', any '%landing page%' (A La Carte, Business Lunch, Dark Brunch at Hutong, Imperial Brunch, Dim Sum Night) and the 'Instagram' campaign tag, per claude/context.md. The London covers view CASE is incomplete here: 'Zomato Concierge' has no slot and is treated as third party, and lower case / initial-surname staff names are matched by an explicit staff list. GROSS basis (all statuses, bar included) is the like for like basis for the GA4 ratio, because GA4 counts a booking when it is made and includes the bar. NET basis excludes cancellations, the bar and staff bookings.

meta.method: GA4 weekly users are deduplicated: one report call per Mon-Sun week with no date dimension, never summed from daily rows. Google bookings use metrics.all_conversions filtered to conversion action 'Hutong Dubai (web) sevenrooms_booking_complete' (the GA4 imported action) only, never raw metrics.conversions. Meta bookings = schedule_total, pulled with time_increment=7 from a Monday start, one call per account per year. trend8 and funnel spend and bookings = Meta + Google combined. funnel.landing = GA4 Paid Search + Paid Social cur sessions. Walk-in = Store visits + Local actions - Directions + Local actions - Menu views + Clicks to call (no 'Click Book Now' action exists on this account). Campaign spend and campaign booking conversions were pulled as two separate GAQL queries because segments.conversion_action_name cannot be selected alongside cost_micros.
